course.title: Power System Operation and Control
course.department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

content.value: A single-phase VSC inverter has a pure inductive load with L = 20 mH. The inverter (15) operates in a square wave fashion with an AC frequency of 50 Hz and Dc voltage of 200 V.
(i) Express the instantaneous converter voltage and current.
(ii) Calculate the peak and rms load current, and
(iii) Calculate the power absorbed by the load.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
